goal: Add an element #match-count whose text is the NUMBER of list items currently visible, updated whenever the filter changes. Everything the page already does must keep working. The page is a single self-contained web page, index.html: plain HTML and JavaScript, no frameworks, no external files or CDNs.

effects: #match-count shows how many items are visible
invariants: typing in the filter still narrows the list

steps.name: loads with no page or console error, showing every item
steps.expect: errors.length === 0 && JSON.stringify(dom.visible.filter((t) => ["copper wire","copper pipe","steel plate","steel rod","brass fitting","nylon washer"].includes(t))) === "[\"copper wire\",\"copper pipe\",\"steel plate\",\"steel rod\",\"brass fitting\",\"nylon washer\"]"

steps.name: typing "copp" narrows the list
steps.expect: JSON.stringify(dom.visible.filter((t) => ["copper wire","copper pipe","steel plate","steel rod","brass fitting","nylon washer"].includes(t))) === "[\"copper wire\",\"copper pipe\"]"

steps.name: clicking #clear-filter brings every item back
steps.expect: JSON.stringify(dom.visible.filter((t) => ["copper wire","copper pipe","steel plate","steel rod","brass fitting","nylon washer"].includes(t))) === "[\"copper wire\",\"copper pipe\",\"steel plate\",\"steel rod\",\"brass fitting\",\"nylon washer\"]"

steps.name: and leaves #q empty
steps.expect: dom.inputValues["#q"] === ''
